# Doree Marina Mall

> Doree is a restaurant occupying a tenancy inside Marina Mall, an enclosed shopping and leisure centre in the United Arab Emirates. The outlet opens directly onto the mall's internal walkways and serves shoppers, cinema-goers and families visiting the centre through the day. It forms part of the mall's food and beverage offer, which sits alongside its fashion, electronics and department-store tenants.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Doree is a restaurant unit at Marina Mall. MENASCO carried out the electrical and mechanical works for the restaurant as a subcontractor to Solid Interiors, the fit-out contractor, delivering the services installation for the dining space. The project is one of many food and beverage and retail fit-outs MENASCO has completed within the UAE's shopping malls.
